$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Azure App Services. One entry per console section; level per substrate (nano = shared core, also dev_server/unified ingress; offline = appliance). Proven by tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py — a claim the backend does not honour fails CI. GCP/Azure probes aren't understood by the shared probe() helper (it speaks AWS wire), so every claim here is proven by `tests` instead.

azure.appservices.webapp.crud.title: Web Apps (create, list, get, delete, start/stop/restart)

azure.appservices.plan.crud.title: App Service plans (create, list, get, delete)
limitations: Capacity/worker metrics are not simulated; SKU is stored but does not change quota enforcement.

azure.appservices.webapp.config.title: Configuration (General settings: stack, platform, TLS, debugging, client certificates)
limitations: Settings are stored and returned to SDKs/az CLI; most (TLS version, FTP state, Always On, ...) are not enforced by a running workload.

azure.appservices.webapp.slots.title: Deployment slots (create, list, delete, swap)
limitations: Swap exchanges config/app settings/connection strings only; no real traffic routing or warm-up.

azure.appservices.webapp.customdomains.title: Custom domains (hostname bindings)
limitations: No real DNS/TXT ownership verification or TLS binding; the hostname is accepted and attached to the site.

azure.appservices.webapp.locks.title: Locks (resource-scoped management locks)
limitations: Locks are stored and listed; they are not enforced against delete/write requests on the resource.

azure.appservices.webapp.logs.title: App Service logs (application logging level, HTTP logs quota/retention)
limitations: Settings round-trip; there is no running workload to actually emit application/HTTP logs.

azure.appservices.webapp.activitylog.title: Activity log
limitations: Records create/update/delete/start/stop/restart/swap operations on the Web App and its sub-resources (slots, custom domains, locks, configuration); filters (severity, timespan, resource group) and export/columns actions are not simulated.

azure.appservices.webapp.iam.title: Access control (IAM)
limitations: Role assignments and role definitions are the generic subscription-scoped Microsoft.Authorization store (shared with every other Azure resource), not filtered to assignments scoped exactly to this Web App.
Deny assignments and classic administrators are always empty (Vyomi models neither).

azure.appservices.webapp.deploymentcente.title: Deployment Center (CI/CD source, FTPS credentials)
limitations: No source-control integration, build pipeline or FTPS deployment credentials.

azure.appservices.webapp.monitoring.title: Monitoring (Alerts, Metrics, Logs, Advisor recommendations, Health check, Diagnostic settings, Log stream, Process explorer)
limitations: Diagnostic settings (Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings) are real: create/list/delete round-trip through the same generic engine every other Azure resource's Diagnostic settings page uses, scoped to this Web App's resource id. Export to the Log Analytics workspace is not simulated (no log/metric pipeline writes land there).
Alerts, Metrics, Logs, Advisor recommendations, Health check, Log stream and Process explorer have no metrics pipeline, alert evaluation or live log/process streaming behind them for Web Apps.

azure.appservices.webapp.devtools.title: Development Tools (Clone App, Console, Advanced Tools, App Service Editor, Extensions)
limitations: No Kudu/SCM console, in-browser editor or site extension gallery.

azure.appservices.webapp.api.title: API (API Management link, API definition, CORS)
limitations: CORS allowed origins / credentials are stored on siteConfig.cors and returned to SDKs/az CLI; Vyomi has no real HTTP layer in front of the app, so the rule is never actually enforced against a cross-origin request.
No API Management linkage or OpenAPI/Swagger definition import.

azure.appservices.webapp.platform.title: Authentication, Identity, Application Insights, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Backups, Certificates, Networking, WebJobs, Service Connector
limitations: Identity: enabling a system-assigned managed identity mints a stable principalId/tenantId that can be the subject of a role assignment on Access control (IAM); user-assigned identities are not modelled.

Backups: modelled as snapshots — backup configuration (storage URL, schedule) and on-demand/scheduled backup records (status, size, timestamp) round-trip for real, and Restore acknowledges, but there is no real site content to archive or replay.
Authentication providers, Application Insights linkage, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, TLS/SSL certificates, VNet integration / private endpoints, WebJobs and Service Connector are not modelled.

azure.appservices.webapp.scale.title: Scale up/out, Change App Service plan, Quotas
limitations: Scale up changes the plan's SKU, Scale out changes siteConfig.numberOfWorkers, and Change App Service plan re-points serverFarmId at another existing plan in the same resource group and OS — all real, round-tripping ARM PATCHes.
No capacity is actually added or removed: Vyomi does not run multiple instances, autoscale rules are not evaluated, and quota usage (Quotas page) is not tracked.

azure.appservices.webapp.automation.title: Automation (Tasks, Export template)
limitations: No Automation Tasks or ARM/Bicep/Terraform template export for the Web App.

azure.appservices.webapp.support.title: Diagnose and solve problems, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Events (preview), Resource visualizer, Resource health, New support request
limitations: No diagnostics engine, Event Grid wiring, resource visualizer, resource-health telemetry or support-ticket flow.
